# homebrew-unsigned-tap

> Homebrew tap restoring all casks disabled by Homebrew for fails_gatekeeper_check (Gatekeeper unsigned). One-click migrate from homebrew/cask disabled to auto-updating.

## Keywords
Homebrew cask disabled fails_gatekeeper_check Gatekeeper unsigned unnotarized quarantine darktable makemkv xld

## Install
```bash
brew tap thedavidweng/unsigned-tap
brew install --cask thedavidweng/unsigned-tap/darktable
```

## Migrate all disabled you have installed
```bash
/bin/bash -c "$(curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/thedavidweng/homebrew-unsigned-tap/main/scripts/migrate.sh)"
```

## Source
Scripts sync from Homebrew/homebrew-cask Casks/**/*.rb where disable! because: :fails_gatekeeper_check, strip disable! + verified, inject postflight xattr -r -d com.apple.quarantine staged_path.
